schema.notes: Reviewer CSV stores OpenAlex W tokens in work_id. Postgres works.id and all ranking/score context appear only in this sidecar.

sampling_policy.suppressed_final_rule: rank > 20 and (final_score below top-20 minimum, final_score < 0.42, or rank >= 120)
sampling_policy.bridge_score_mismatch_rule: rank > 20 and bridge_score >= p75 and final_score below top-20 median when bridge_score exists
sampling_policy.csv_ordering: seeded hash shuffle over selected rows; not final_score order
